description: This Java class defines a visitor, CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor, which traverses a permission policy tree to collect authorization subjects that have specific permissions granted (not revoked). It evaluates permissions on resource nodes and collects subjects based on whether the permissions are effectively granted.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that traverses a policy tree to collect authorization subjects with specific granted permissions.

methods.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.description: Visits a tree node, dispatching to subject or resource node handling.

methods.description: Returns the set of authorization subjects that have the expected permissions granted.
